in_sanskrit.name: Ayyanar
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the village
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ayyanar एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The guardian deity of agriculture, fertility, and health. Ayyanar is believed to protect villages from evil and bring prosperity.

in_marathi.name: Ayyanar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the village
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ayyanar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The guardian deity of agriculture, fertility, and health. Ayyanar is believed to protect villages from evil and bring prosperity.

in_bengali.name: Ayyanar
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the village
in_bengali.long_meaning: Ayyanar একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The guardian deity of agriculture, fertility, and health. Ayyanar is believed to protect villages from evil and bring prosperity.
